title: Nvidia's NVentures joins CFS's $863M Series B2 fusion round

sources.quote: DEVENS, Mass. (Aug. 28, 2025) — Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS), the largest and leading private fusion company, today announced that it raised $863 million in a Series B2 fundraising round as it moves closer to being the first in the world to commercialize fusion power.
In this latest oversubscribed round, the company brought on new investors, including NVentures, Nvidia’s venture capital arm.

explain: Nvidia's venture arm NVentures was a new investor in Commonwealth Fusion Systems' $863 million Series B2 round, which funds the SPARC demo machine and the planned ARC power plant. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.
